options: Observe or use evidence, connect it to the concept, and explain the conclusion.

items.question: Explain needs and wants and give one everyday example.
items.answer: A strong answer gives an accurate explanation and a relevant example.

options: Use major ideas independently in a new situation and explain the reasoning.
Finish the lesson without checking understanding.

flashcards.back: Define needs and wants, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define production, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define services, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define exchange and livelihoods, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore needs and wants
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on needs and wants. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where production is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach exchange and livelihoods to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
